mentions.name: Hiring platform for recruiters
mentions.description: A hiring platform that automates routine recruiting tasks. The MVP reduces applications from candidates who are not serious or clearly not a fit, and it adds features that are hard to bolt onto existing ATS software, such as keeping compensation information private from the interview team while communicating with candidates.
mentions.problem: Routine recruiting tasks consume recruiters' time, and existing ATS software lacks features such as filtering out non-serious or poor-fit applicants and keeping compensation information private.
mentions.source_excerpt: Been working on a hiring platform that I’ve always wanted.

evidence.value: Been working on a hiring platform that I’ve always wanted.
evidence.author: MikeNotThePope
